Source distinctions and conflicts

  • CdSe baseline stock gives Se:Cd(CH3)2:tributylphosphine = 2:5:100 by mass; discussion separately describes Cd:Se about 1.4:1 by mole. Preserve both approximate descriptions without replacing either.
